title.zh-CN: 风险预算：先定亏得起，再谈仓位
title.en: Risk budget: decide what you can lose before sizing

summary.zh-CN: 仓位不是勇气问题，是「这笔最多能亏多少」先写清楚。
summary.en: Position size follows a written max-loss — not courage.

zh-CN: 很多人先问「该买多少」，却没问「亏多少还能睡得着」。风险预算把顺序反过来。
一、写下单笔最大可接受亏损（金额或账户百分比），再反推仓位。
二、用站内仓位工具把假设算出来；数字是假设，不是信号。
三、把失效条件写进提醒或笔记；突破假设就停手复盘，而不是加仓赌一口气。
本工具仅供学习，不构成投资建议。
en: Many people ask “how much to buy” before “how much loss I can sleep with.” Risk budget reverses that order.
1) Write a max loss per trade (cash or % of equity), then back into size.
2) Use the position tool to check assumptions — numbers are not a buy signal.
3) Put invalidation in alerts or notes; if breached, stop and review instead of averaging down on hope.
For learning only; not investment advice.
